basic_info.description: 202 Fair Oaks is City Landmark #191 - a timeless San Francisco Victorian with modern upgrades and classic style that fits well with today's living. High ceilings, ornate ceiling medallions, original doors and woodwork reflect the unmatched craftsmanship of 19th century construction. On the main level a foyer opens to formal living and dining rooms, each with marble fireplaces and lovely outlooks. The light-filled kitchen with marble counters and center island opens to shared outdoor space - a large, sun-filled deck filled with well-cared-for plants. A powder room, laundry closet, and spacious pantry with coat closet complete the main level.  A staircase lit by a stained glass skylight leads up to a main bedroom suite and guest bedroom separated by an office/den with built-ins.  The guest room's French doors open to a balcony and the deck.  Guest bathroom has a unique shower by a local glass artist. The newly remodeled primary suite includes marble fireplace, luxurious bathroom with marble floor and vanity. This move-in ready townhome comes with a large private one-car garage and spacious storage room. The location offers quick access to the Mission, Noe Valley, Dolores Park, and multiple public transportation options.
